loss_definition: All arms same balanced channel/decade fit-only sampling. L=mean((log10(pred+1e-30)-log10(target+1e-30))^2)/900 + lambda*mean((pred-target)^2), lambda0/1/10. Fixed representation and lambda contrasts; same matrices perseed.
selection: Same development score logMSE/900+absoluteMSE for every arm, earliest ties; freeze before fresh. Also save both component scores and all checkpoints. No fresh-based winner selection.

cost.scope: Static packed18models versus analytic product; not matched-workload speedup.

hypotheses.claim: Adding absolute loss repairs large openings without destroying tiny-opening accuracy.
hypotheses.contrast: lambda0/1/10, same representation and sampled rows.

hypotheses.claim: Log output versus sigmoid changes the tradeoff.
hypotheses.contrast: Two output representations under each identical hybrid objective.

limitations: Static full-state gate-to-opening mapping only; no memory, recurrence or compression qualification. Synthetic and reachable outputs separate. Evaluation uses unchanged amplitude thresholds on sampled trajectories, not dense temporal/event qualification.51b allarms failed; P frozen unchanged.
